description: This source file contains a PHP class interface for Redmine integration within a testlink project, including configuration settings, connection testing, and issue management functions.

classes.name: redminerestInterface
classes.description: A class providing methods to connect to Redmine REST API, add issues, and retrieve issue details.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue in Redmine with the specified title and description.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific issue from Redmine by ID.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Tests the connection to Redmine using the provided API key.
